candidates.claim: VLAN 10 is allowed on the non-OT-facing trunks sw-core-01 Gi1/0/22, sw-core-01 Gi1/0/24 and sw-ot-01 Gi1/0/24, which is in tension with the rule that only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10.
Interface GigabitEthernet1/0/23 on sw-it-01 has access VLAN 30, where the approved baseline has access VLAN 999.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile with the approved baseline: confirm the change is authorized, or restore VLAN 999 on Gi1/0/23.

candidates.claim: The shutdown command on interface GigabitEthernet1/0/23 of sw-it-01 is absent from the current configuration, although the approved baseline has it shut and the registry lists this port as unused.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile with the approved baseline: confirm the port should be active, or re-apply shutdown on Gi1/0/23.

clarifications.question: The approved-trunk table permits VLAN 10 on sw-core-01 Gi1/0/22 {10,99}, sw-core-01 Gi1/0/24 {10,20,30,99} and sw-ot-01 Gi1/0/24 {10,99}, but the rule says only OT-facing ports (sw-ot-01 Gi1/0/1-16) may be active in VLAN 10. Should these approved core and uplink trunks be treated as compliant, or as violations of I3?
